title: White elder dragon at rest (G12b) — capture set
intro: ?view=white-dragon on the dev server: the dragon in render 08's pose on the stand-in tower top, the real sky in the late afternoon (tod 0.66; at 0.7 the low sun ahead of render 08's camera hazes the picture orange), clear weather, quality high, SwiftShader unless run with --gpu. The named cameras share render 08's narrower lens (38° vertical) unless an item gives fov=62, the game's own. Every item re-stages fresh dragons (the idle from rest); time moves only in exact 1/30 s frames, so the same manifest gives the same frames. Azimuths are relative to the dragon's heading: 0 in front, 90 its left side.
